content_sections.heading: About Nainital Bank
content_sections.text: The Nainital Bank Limited describes itself as a Private Sector Scheduled Commercial Bank around a century old, established in 1922 by Bharat Ratna Late Pt. Govind Ballabh Pant and a few other prominent personalities of Nainital. It has 3 Regional Offices, at Haldwani, Dehradun and Noida, and a network of 178 branches across Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana and Rajasthan. Its Head Office is at Seven Oaks, Mallital, Nainital- 263001 (Uttarakhand), and its registered office is on G.B. Pant Road, Nainital.

content_sections.heading: Nainital Bank HR Advisor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be a minimum of 50 years and a maximum of 65 years of age as on 31 October 2026. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Superannuated, retired or VRS opted in Grade/Scale of AGM and above. Must have worked in any public sector bank. Must have an understanding of labour laws, HR and IR issues, organizational policies and people management. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: HR Advisor Job Profile
content_sections.text: Advise management on HR policies, automation and compliance. Support strategic workforce planning, capacity building and succession planning of the bank. Handle training assessment, HR technology and analytics. Mentor and guide the existing HR team. Assist in disciplinary, legal and employee relations matters. Advise on IR issues, deployment, employee engagement and welfare. Ensure fair treatment of staff in line with employment laws and company policy. Interpret and enforce HR policies and procedures. Assist in drafting and updating HR policies and employee handbooks. Assist in managing performance review cycles. Advise managers on performance improvement plans and goal setting. Support succession planning and talent management initiatives. Take up any other HR matters related to the bank assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience. The requisite number of shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Final selection is made on the Personal Interview. Meeting the eligibility norms does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. The bank reserves the right to reject any application not suitable to its requirement without assigning any reason, and to call only the requisite number of eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years. The bank may terminate the contract during the contractual period by one month's notice or compensation in lieu thereof.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Nainital Bank HR Advisor post?
faq.answer: Officers who superannuated, retired or opted for VRS in Grade/Scale of AGM and above, and who worked in any public sector bank, can apply if they are within the age limit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit, and on which date is it counted?
faq.answer: The limit is 50 to 65 years, counted as on 31 October 2026, the same date the notification was issued.

faq.question: Q3. What knowledge does the bank expect from candidates?
faq.answer: The notice asks for an understanding of labour laws, HR and IR issues, organizational policies and people management.

faq.question: Q4. Is the yearly pay capped?
faq.answer: Yes. The maximum offered is Rs.12.00 lakh per annum.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: The first term is 1 year, and it can be extended up to 3 years. Either way, the bank can end it early by one month's notice or compensation in lieu.

faq.question: Q6. Will every eligible applicant be called for interview?
faq.answer: No. Only the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called, based on eligibility and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What must be done before the application is emailed?
faq.answer: A recent photograph must be pasted at the appropriate place, and the candidate must sign the form. The prescribed documents go with the application.

faq.question: Q8. What will the HR Advisor work on?
faq.answer: The work covers HR policy and compliance advice, workforce and succession planning, mentoring the HR team, disciplinary and employee relations matters, and performance review cycles.
